methods.returns: nothing (empty response)
methods.notes: No call site in the desktop app.

methods.name: DeleteGrokBotUserFormVaultEntry
methods.function: Deletes one entry from the autofill vault by id.
methods.returns: nothing (empty response)
methods.notes: No call site in the desktop app.

methods.name: ListGrokBotUserFormVaultKeys
methods.function: Lists the keys of the autofill vault entries (extra key and origin host) without their values.
methods.returns: keys: extraKey, originHost
methods.notes: Metadata only. No call site in the desktop app.

methods.name: PublishGrokBotUserSkillsSnapshot
methods.function: Publishes a snapshot of the user's skills, identified by a fingerprint string. The exact purpose is not visible.
methods.returns: nothing (empty response)
methods.notes: No call site in the desktop app. The fingerprint is probably a hash of the skill set, but this is a guess.

methods.name: InvalidateGrokBotUserSkillsCache
methods.function: Clears a server-side cache of the user's skills. It takes no input and returns nothing.
methods.returns: nothing (empty response)
methods.notes: No call site in the desktop app. The 0.71.2 schema confirms an empty request and an empty response; the purpose comes from the name only.

methods.name: GetGrokBotOnePasswordExtensionDownload
methods.function: Returns download details for a 1Password browser extension package, if the feature is enabled. The request says whether the caller can accept a store CRX.
methods.returns: enabled, url, treeDigest, expiresAtMs, crxSha256
methods.notes: No call site in the desktop app. The URL has an expiry time, so it is probably signed.

methods.name: EnsureSandBox
methods.function: Finds the caller's Sand box (cloud computer), starts it if needed, and returns everything needed to connect to it. The desktop app calls it on every connect and also to check the box state.
methods.inputs: wake (false means report the state without starting a sleeping box); supports_asleep_box (true means the client accepts a hibernated answer).
methods.returns: Cluster, tenant id, pod id, run state (ABSENT, HIBERNATED, RUNNING, STARTING), exec daemon URL and token, VNC URL, gateway URL and token, network token, terminals folder, fork VNC base URL, image info, image_update_available, egress tunnel ownership flag.
methods.notes: Tested live 14 Oct 2026: HTTP 200, returned gatewayUrl, gatewayToken, networkToken, vncUrl and forkVncBaseUrl (never log the tokens). Calling <gatewayUrl>/api/<method> with Authorization: Bearer <gatewayToken> and x-anyrun-network-token: <networkToken> gives direct access to the 167 Box Gateway methods, including updateAgent (which immediately syncs to ListGrokBotAgents on api2.cursor.sh) and getAgentWorkflows / importAgentWorkflowText / deleteAgentWorkflow (which work on private bots).

methods.name: EnsureSandBoxWindow
methods.function: Takes a window number and returns the same connection response as EnsureSandBox, giving access to one bot's numbered desktop window on the box.
methods.returns: Same response as EnsureSandBox: cluster, pod, run state, URLs and tokens.
methods.notes: Confirmed on 14 Oct 2026 by inspecting /home/box/.sand-window-assignments.json on the box: each bot agentId is assigned its own window number (Grok Bot = 2, Primary Test = 3, Staff Test = 4, up to SAND_BOX_MAX_WINDOWS = 100) and runs with DISPLAY=:<window_index>. Response holds credentials.

methods.name: RecreateSandBox
methods.function: Asks the backend to rebuild the caller's Sand box, with or without keeping its data. The desktop app uses it for its recreate computer action and then follows progress with WatchSandBoxMigration.
methods.inputs: preserve_data; force (the app always sends false); acknowledge_terminal_upgrade_schedule (optional, the app leaves it false unless set by its caller).
methods.returns: started (true or false), a reason when it was rejected, and an operation_id to follow the rebuild.
methods.notes: Not probed. Setting preserve_data to false most likely wipes the box data (inferred from the name and the WIPING migration phase). A rejection comes back as started=false with a reason, not as an error.

methods.name: ForceRecreateSandBox
methods.function: A second rebuild call that takes no input. The app exposes it as its own forceRecreate action and reads the same result as RecreateSandBox.
methods.returns: started, reason and operation_id (same response type as RecreateSandBox).
methods.notes: Not probed. The app code does not show what 'force' skips compared with the normal recreate. Treat it as at least as destructive as RecreateSandBox.

methods.name: PresignSandBoxStoreWrites
methods.function: Returns presigned upload URLs so files can be written to the box's object store directly. Each requested file carries its sha256, size and optional write preconditions.
methods.inputs: files: rel_path, sha256, size_bytes, content_addressed flag, if_match_etag or expect_absent precondition, and a multipart part list for big files.
methods.returns: One instruction per file: URL, headers, expiry time, and a multipart upload plan when the file is large.
methods.notes: Not called by the desktop app. Likely used by the box side or another client (inference). Pairs with CompleteSandBoxStoreMultipartWrites and CommitSandBoxStoreManifest. Presigned URLs are bearer links, do not log them.

methods.name: CompleteSandBoxStoreMultipartWrites
methods.function: Finishes large uploads that were sent in parts, by giving back each part number and its etag.
methods.inputs: completions: for each upload, its context (upload_id, rel_path, size, sha256, expected part count, preconditions, session_id) and the uploaded parts (part number, etag).
methods.returns: One result per input: input_index, rel_path, and either success with the final etag or a failure code (for example PRECONDITION_FAILED, UPLOAD_NOT_FOUND, INVALID_PARTS, CHECKSUM_MISMATCH, TRANSIENT, INTERNAL).
methods.notes: Not called by the desktop app.

methods.name: CommitSandBoxStoreManifest
methods.function: Saves a new manifest (the index of files in the box store) if the stored one still matches base_etag. This guards against overwriting a newer manifest.
methods.returns: status (COMMITTED, RETRY or FENCED) and the new etag.
methods.notes: Not called by the desktop app. The exact meaning of FENCED is not shown.

methods.name: AbortSandBoxStoreMultipartWrites
methods.function: Cancels multipart uploads that were started but not completed.
methods.inputs: uploads: the upload context of each upload to cancel.
methods.returns: One result per input: success (with an already_finished flag) or a failure code.
methods.notes: Not called by the desktop app.

methods.name: PresignSandBoxStoreReads
methods.function: Returns presigned download URLs for files in the box store. The desktop app uses it to fetch large transcript entries that are stored as blobs/<hash> instead of inline.
methods.inputs: rel_paths: list of store paths (the app sends blobs/<hash>).
methods.returns: One instruction per path: rel_path, URL, expiry time.
methods.notes: Not probed. This is the only store method the desktop app calls. It downloads the URLs with plain GET (404 means the blob is missing), up to 8 at a time, with a 30 second limit each. URLs are bearer links, do not log them.

methods.name: StatSandBoxStoreObject
methods.function: Checks one object in the box store by relative path: whether it exists, its etag, size and last-modified time.
methods.returns: exists, etag, size_bytes, last_modified_ms.
methods.notes: Probe with an empty path returned 200 and an empty body, which in proto JSON means exists=false and zero values. Not called by the desktop app.

methods.name: ListSandBoxStoreObjects
methods.function: Lists objects in the box store, optionally under a path prefix, with a cursor for paging.
methods.returns: entries (rel_path, etag, size_bytes, last_modified_ms), next_cursor, truncated flag.
methods.notes: Probe returned 200 with 1000 entries, and truncated and next_cursor were set (proto JSON omits defaults), so there are more pages. Paths are the owner's files, do not publish them. Not called by the desktop app.

methods.name: WatchSandBoxMigration
methods.function: Streams progress events while the box is rebuilt or moved. Each event has a phase (BACKING_UP, CREATING, MOVING, CLEANING_UP, WIPING, DONE, FAILED), a detail text and an operation id.
methods.inputs: from_offset_key (resume point, empty to start); include_finished (the app sends true).
methods.returns: A stream of events: phase, detail, at_ms, offset_key, operation_id.
methods.notes: Not probed (streaming). The app saves the last offset_key, restarts the stream when it stalls, and resumes from the saved key.

methods.name: GetSandBoxRunState
methods.function: Reads the box state without starting it: absent, hibernated, running or starting, plus whether a newer image is available. The app calls it just before EnsureSandBox to show a connecting phase.
methods.returns: state (ABSENT, HIBERNATED, RUNNING, STARTING), image_update_available, egress_tunnel_ownership, image (registry_tag, static_snapshot_path).
methods.notes: Probe returned 200 with all four fields present. Values are not recorded here.

methods.name: GetSandBoxUpgradeSchedule
methods.function: Reads the saved schedule for upgrading the box to a newer image. The app shows it in its computer upgrade settings.
methods.returns: schedule: timezone, local_time, recurring, state (SCHEDULED, CLAIMED, RUNNING, WAITING_FOR_IMAGE, COMPLETED, MISSED, FAILED, CANCELLED), next_fire_at_ms, target image tag, last completed image tag, failure_reason, target_artifact_ref, last_completed_artifact_ref.
methods.notes: Probe with an empty body returned 400 invalid_argument (ERROR_BAD_REQUEST). The app sends the same empty body, so the cause is not known.

methods.name: ScheduleSandBoxUpgrade
methods.function: Creates the upgrade schedule: upgrade the box at a given local time of day in a time zone, once or on a recurring basis.
methods.returns: schedule (same fields as GetSandBoxUpgradeSchedule).
methods.notes: Not probed. Applying the upgrade probably recreates the box from a newer image (inferred from target_image_tag and the WAITING_FOR_IMAGE state), which could interrupt running work.

methods.name: CancelSandBoxUpgrade
methods.function: Cancels the upgrade schedule. The dismiss flag also clears a finished, missed or failed record so it stops showing (inferred from the name).
methods.returns: schedule (state after the cancel).
methods.notes: Not probed.

methods.name: RescheduleSandBoxUpgrade
methods.function: Changes the time or repeat setting of an existing upgrade schedule.
methods.returns: schedule (updated).
methods.notes: Not probed.

methods.name: ListSandBoxes
methods.function: Lists the caller's boxes. Each entry only has a running flag.
methods.returns: boxes: list of entries with a running flag.
methods.notes: Lists the caller's boxes; each entry only has a running flag. 14 Oct 2026: one box for the whole account. Two test bots and the main bot report the same hostname, so all bots share one cloud computer, and a test bot's command woke it from hibernation.

methods.name: NotifySandAgentTurnFinished
methods.function: Tells the backend that an agent finished a turn, with the agent name, a short message preview, the last message id and whether the agent now waits for the user. It probably drives notifications (inferred from the fields).
methods.inputs: agent_id, agent_name, message_preview, last_message_id, awaiting_user_response, member_agent_ids, sender_agent_id, message_content_json.
methods.returns: none (empty response).
methods.notes: Not called by the desktop app. The caller is probably the box (inference).

methods.name: ListSandSetupManifests
methods.function: Lists the setup manifests assigned to the caller's box. Each has a scope (USER, TEAM or ORGANIZATION), a revision and entries (id, setup text, optional check text).
methods.returns: schema_version, manifests, and team_secrets (name and value pairs per team) when asked for.
methods.notes: Sensitive when include_team_secrets is true, because it returns secret values. Probe used the default and returned 200 with only schema_version, so the owner has no manifests. Not called by the desktop app.

methods.name: ListTeamSandSetupManifests
methods.function: Lists the team's shared setup manifests and says whether the caller may manage them.
methods.returns: team_id, can_manage, manifests (manifest_id, revision, etag, entries).
methods.notes: Probe returned 200 with an empty body (no team data on the owner's account). Compare ListTeamGroupSandSetupManifests, which refused the same account.

methods.name: SaveTeamSandSetupManifest
methods.function: Creates or replaces one shared team setup manifest. expected_etag stops it from overwriting a newer edit.
methods.inputs: manifest_id; expected_etag; entries (id, setup text, optional check text).
methods.returns: manifest (saved version with revision and etag).
methods.notes: Not called by the desktop app. Needs a team and manage rights (inferred from can_manage on the list call).

methods.name: DeleteTeamSandSetupManifest
methods.function: Deletes one shared team setup manifest.
methods.returns: none (empty response).
methods.notes: Not called by the desktop app. Needs a team and manage rights (inferred).

methods.name: ListTeamGroupSandSetupManifests
methods.function: Lists the setup manifests of one team group, picked by its public id.
methods.returns: team_id, can_manage, manifests.
methods.notes: Probe was refused with code unauthenticated and message 'A team is required to manage setup manifests.' It needs a team account.

methods.name: SaveTeamGroupSandSetupManifest
methods.function: Creates or replaces one setup manifest for a team group. expected_etag stops it from overwriting a newer edit.
methods.inputs: group_id (int64, sent as a JSON string); manifest_id; expected_etag; entries.
methods.returns: manifest (saved version).
methods.notes: Not called by the desktop app. Needs a team (see the probe error on ListTeamGroupSandSetupManifests).

methods.name: DeleteTeamGroupSandSetupManifest
methods.function: Deletes one setup manifest of a team group.
methods.inputs: group_id (int64, sent as a JSON string); manifest_id; expected_etag.
methods.returns: none (empty response).
methods.notes: Not called by the desktop app. Needs a team.

methods.name: DeleteTeamGrokBot
methods.function: Deletes a team's bot (agent) by team id and agent id. The response reports what happened to the bot's Slack app (removed flag, workspace name, status).
methods.returns: slack_app_removal: removed, slack_workspace_name, status.
methods.notes: Not called by the desktop app. Probably needs team admin rights (inference). Compare AdminDeleteGrokBotAgent, the staff version.

methods.name: ListTeamMemberSandBoxes
methods.function: Lists the Sand box pods of one team member: cluster, pod id, tenant, flavor, run state, image tag, created and last active times, and any failure reason. scan_incomplete says the scan did not cover everything.
methods.returns: user_id, email, name, boxes (pods), scan_incomplete.
methods.notes: Probe sent no ids and got 400 invalid_argument. Needs a team and probably admin rights (inference). Not called by the desktop app.

methods.name: KillTeamMemberSandBox
methods.function: Deletes one pod of a team member's box, picked by pod_id and cluster.
methods.returns: killed, reason, deleted_count.
methods.notes: Not called by the desktop app. Probably needs team admin rights (inference).

methods.name: RecreateTeamMemberSandBox
methods.function: Rebuilds a team member's Sand box, with an optional force flag. It returns the same result type as RecreateSandBox.
methods.returns: started, reason, operation_id.
methods.notes: Not called by the desktop app. Probably needs team admin rights (inference). Follow progress with GetTeamMemberSandBoxMigrationStatus.

methods.name: GetTeamMemberSandBoxMigrationStatus
methods.function: Reads the latest rebuild or migration event of a team member's box, so an admin can follow a recreate.
methods.returns: event (optional): phase, detail, at_ms, offset_key, operation_id.
methods.notes: Probe sent no ids and got 400 invalid_argument. Not called by the desktop app.

methods.name: StartBulkTeamMemberSandBoxOperation
methods.function: Starts one action on the boxes of many team members at once. The action is KILL, RECREATE or PERMANENT_DELETE.
methods.inputs: team_id; user_ids; action; force; operation_id; clear_sand_box_restart_required.
methods.returns: operation_id, to follow with GetBulkTeamMemberSandBoxOperationStatus.
methods.notes: Not called by the desktop app. PERMANENT_DELETE is in the action list. Probably needs team admin rights (inference).

methods.name: GetBulkTeamMemberSandBoxOperationStatus
methods.function: Reads the progress of a bulk box action: overall state, counts, and a state per user.
methods.returns: action, state (RUNNING, SUCCEEDED, PARTIALLY_SUCCEEDED, FAILED), counts (total, queued, running, succeeded, skipped, failed, no-box skipped), items per user (user_id, state, reason, recreate_operation_id), items_truncated.
methods.notes: Probe sent no ids and got 400 invalid_argument. Not called by the desktop app.

methods.name: MintSandVoiceCallSecret
methods.function: Creates a short-lived client secret for a realtime voice call. The desktop app calls it when the user starts a voice call, and gets back the secret, its expiry, the model name and a websocket URL.
methods.inputs: model (optional; the app sends it empty).
methods.returns: client_secret, expires_at_unix_seconds, model, websocket_url.
methods.notes: Not probed. The secret is a credential, never log it. A refusal arrives in the x-grok-bot-refusal response header. The app waits up to 15 seconds.

methods.name: ReportSandBoxHostState
methods.function: Lets the host software on the box report its health to the backend: disk pressure level (NONE, SOFT, HARD), host version, and whether a host update is available.
methods.returns: none (empty response).
methods.notes: Not called by the desktop app. The caller is probably the host inside the box (inference). The staff-side reader is AdminGetSandBoxHostStatus.

methods.name: EnsureGrokBotDefaultMainAgent
methods.function: Makes sure the user has a default main (primary) bot, and returns its id with an outcome. The desktop app calls it from its main-agent settings code, next to the get and set calls for the main agent.
methods.returns: agent_id and outcome (CREATED, PRESENT, HAS_MAIN_AGENT, TOMBSTONED, PINNED_FULL, BUSY).
methods.notes: Not probed. It can create a bot when none exists. What TOMBSTONED, PINNED_FULL and BUSY mean is not shown in the app code.

methods.name: EnsureGrokBotBoxHarnessMigrationPass
methods.function: Sent with an operation id and the list of rooms the box hosts, and returns the state of one harness migration pass: DISABLED, DONE or PENDING. It looks like a step in moving an agent's run loop between the box and the server (inferred).
methods.returns: state (DISABLED, DONE, PENDING).
methods.notes: Not called by the desktop app. The 'harness' reading is inferred from the BOX and TEMPORAL harness enum and from the staff methods about harness migration.

methods.name: EndGrokBotBoxHandoff
methods.function: Ends a handoff of the bot's own computer (the 'forever box') back to the agent, when the user hands control back (direction inferred from the action name and trigger names). The desktop app sends the agent id, the request id and the trigger.
methods.returns: dispatched (true or false) and an optional workflow_id.
methods.notes: Not probed. The app action is named handBackForeverBox. The app maps a stale-request failure for this action to the code box-handoff/stale. A workflow_id suggests a workflow is started so the agent can resume (inferred).

methods.name: GetGrokBotEgressPolicy
methods.function: Reads the outbound network rules enforced on the live box: a restricted flag, allowed domains, and allowed TCP destinations (CIDR plus port). The desktop app uses it to decide whether its local egress tunnel may connect to a host and port.
methods.returns: restricted, allowed_domains, allowed_tcp_destinations (cidr, port).
methods.notes: Probe returned 404 not_found: 'no live Sand box pod to enforce an egress policy for', because no box was live. The app treats restricted=false as no limits, and applies domain rules to ports 80 and 443 only.

methods.name: VoiceCallHarnessSession
methods.function: Asks the backend how to run a voice call for a bot. It returns the call instructions, the tool list, an overheard flag, a greeting and a receipt plan.
methods.inputs: agent_id; agent_name; user_name, description, spoken_language (all optional).
methods.returns: instructions, tools (type, name, description, parameters), has_overheard, greeting (direction, with_landed_work), receipt (output, instructions).
methods.notes: Not probed. The app uses the backend only when the sand_voice_server_harness feature gate is on; otherwise it uses a local package mode. It sends the x-cursor-timezone header.

methods.name: VoiceCallHarnessTool
methods.function: Runs one tool call from the voice model on the backend, and returns the tool result.
methods.inputs: agent_id; call_id; name (tool name); input (JSON); line (they_just_talked, news_owed, receipt_owed, already_spoke_this_turn).
methods.returns: kind (SERVED, UNKNOWN_TOOL, INVALID_INPUT) and output (JSON).
methods.notes: Not probed. Same feature gate as VoiceCallHarnessSession. The app checks the output against its own schema for the tool.

methods.name: EnsureGrokBotCursorMainBot
methods.function: Probably creates or returns a 'Cursor main bot' for the user, and says whether it was created. This reading comes from the name and the response fields only.
methods.returns: agent (full agent record) and created flag.
methods.notes: Not called by the desktop app. The 0.71.2 schema confirms an empty request and a response of agent plus created. How it differs from EnsureGrokBotDefaultMainAgent is not shown.

methods.name: AdminRecreateSandBox
methods.function: Back-office rebuild of one user's Sand box, picked by auth_id and flavor.
methods.returns: started, reason, operation_id (same type as RecreateSandBox).

methods.name: AdminForceRecreateSandBox
methods.function: Back-office forced rebuild of one user's Sand box.
methods.returns: started, reason, operation_id.

methods.name: AdminBreakGlassDeleteSandBoxPod
methods.function: Emergency delete of one named pod of a user's box. The operator's email is recorded, and the response says whether a recreate was started.
methods.returns: deleted, reason, started, recreate_reason, operation_id.

methods.name: AdminGetSandBoxStoreStatus
methods.function: Reads the state of one user's box object store.
methods.returns: durable, entry_count, total_bytes, last_snapshot_at_ms, reachable.
methods.notes: The dossier showed no schema for this method. Request and response were read from the service table in the app bundle.

methods.name: AdminUpdateSandBoxHost
methods.function: Starts an update of the host software on one user's box, optionally forced.
methods.returns: started, reason, version.

methods.name: AdminGetSandBoxHostStatus
methods.function: Reads the host status of one user's box: gateway reachable, host version, update available, latest version, busy flag and last busy time.
methods.returns: gateway_reachable, host_version, host_update_available, latest_host_version, is_busy, last_busy_at_ms.
methods.notes: The dossier showed no schema for this method. Request and response were read from the service table in the app bundle.

methods.name: AdminSnapshotSandBoxStore
methods.function: Takes a snapshot of one user's box store right now.
methods.returns: ok, manifest_entries, files_uploaded, reason.

methods.name: AdminListSandBoxStoreManifestVersions
methods.function: Lists the saved manifest versions (snapshots) of one user's box store, with paging.
methods.inputs: auth_id; flavor; cursor; max_versions; parse_limit; before_timestamp_ms.
methods.returns: store_id, versions (version_id, time, size, is_latest, etag, entry_count, total_bytes, parse_error), next_cursor, truncated, time_scan_capped.

methods.name: AdminStatSandBoxStoreObject
methods.function: Inspects one stored object by S3 link: whether it exists, size, version, and its encryption settings (including the bucket defaults and the expected key). It looks like a storage encryption diagnostic.
methods.returns: bucket, key, exists, version_id, size_bytes, last_modified_ms, etag, server-side encryption and KMS key details, bucket default encryption, expected_key.

methods.name: AdminRestoreSandBoxStoreSnapshot
methods.function: Restores one user's box store to a chosen manifest version. expected_entry_count works as a safety check.
methods.returns: started, reason, operation_id, current_entry_count, target_entry_count.

methods.name: AdminHibernateSandBox
methods.function: Puts one user's box to sleep, optionally forced.
methods.returns: started, reason.

methods.name: AdminRefreshSandBoxEgress
methods.function: Pushes the current outbound network rules to one user's box. The trigger says if it is a single or a bulk refresh, with an optional team id.
methods.inputs: auth_id; flavor; trigger (SINGLE or BULK); team_id.
methods.returns: status (PUSHED, NO_BOX, ERROR), cluster, tenant, pod, runtime_applied, http_proxy_rule_count, label outcome and reason, error.

methods.name: AdminListSandAgents
methods.function: Lists the agents that live on one user's box, read through the box. The list comes back as JSON text.
methods.returns: reachable, agents_json, reason.
methods.notes: Exposes data from a user's box.

methods.name: AdminGetSandAgentTranscriptPage
methods.function: Reads one page of an agent's transcript from one user's box, by sequence number or time range. The entries come back as JSON text.
methods.inputs: auth_id; flavor; agent_id; before_seq; limit; since_ms; until_ms; session_id.
methods.returns: reachable, entries_json, reason, next_before_seq, session_id.
methods.notes: Exposes private conversation content.

methods.name: AdminWatchSandBoxMigration
methods.function: Streams rebuild or move progress events for one user's box. It is the staff version of WatchSandBoxMigration.
methods.returns: A stream of events: phase, detail, at_ms, offset_key, operation_id.

methods.name: ListGrokBotMarketplaceCreatorsInternal
methods.function: Lists marketplace creator profiles, with paging.
methods.returns: creators and next_page_token.

methods.name: GetGrokBotMarketplaceCreatorInternal
methods.function: Reads one marketplace creator profile by id.
methods.returns: The creator.
methods.notes: The dossier showed no response schema. The creator type was read from the service table in the app bundle.

methods.name: UpdateGrokBotMarketplaceCreatorInternal
methods.function: Edits a marketplace creator profile: name, photo and handles.
methods.inputs: creator_id; optional name and profile_photo_url; handles; replace_handles.
methods.returns: The updated creator.

methods.name: PresignGrokBotMarketplaceCreatorProfileUploadInternal
methods.function: Returns an upload URL for a creator's profile photo.
methods.returns: put_url and public_url.
methods.notes: The dossier showed no response schema. The response type is the same as PresignGrokBotMarketplaceImageUploadInternal, read from the service table.

methods.name: PreviewGrokBotMarketplaceSourceInternal
methods.function: Checks a source reference for a possible listing without creating it. It says whether the source is eligible and why not.
methods.returns: template_id, share_id, name, description, avatar shape and color, published, active_version, eligible, ineligibility_reason.

methods.name: CreateGrokBotMarketplaceCategoryInternal
methods.function: Creates a marketplace category.
methods.returns: The category (id, name).
methods.notes: The dossier showed no response schema. The category type was read from the service table in the app bundle.

methods.name: ListGrokBotMarketplaceCategoriesInternal
methods.function: Lists marketplace categories, with paging.
methods.returns: categories and next_page_token.

methods.name: GetGrokBotMarketplaceCategoryInternal
methods.function: Reads one marketplace category by id.
methods.returns: The category.
methods.notes: The dossier showed no response schema. The category type was read from the service table in the app bundle.

methods.name: UpdateGrokBotMarketplaceCategoryInternal
methods.function: Renames a marketplace category.
methods.returns: The updated category.

methods.name: GetGrokBotMarketplaceListingTemplateInternal
methods.function: Reads the recipe (the bot setup as JSON) behind a marketplace listing.
methods.returns: recipe_json.

methods.name: GetGrokBotMarketplaceListingSourceTemplateInternal
methods.function: Reads the recipe of the source template version a listing points to.
methods.returns: recipe_json, template_version_id, version.

methods.name: DeleteGrokBotMarketplaceListingInternal
methods.function: Deletes a marketplace listing.
methods.returns: none (empty response).

methods.name: UpdateGrokBotMarketplaceListingTemplateInternal
methods.function: Replaces the recipe (bot setup JSON) of a listing's template.
methods.returns: recipe_json.
methods.notes: The dossier showed no response schema. The response type was read from the service table in the app bundle.

methods.name: GetGrokBotTemplateForOperatorInternal
methods.function: Reads a bot template by share id in an operator view: name, description, published flag, creator attribution and public byline.
methods.returns: share_id, name, description, published, creator_attribution, public_byline.
methods.notes: The dossier showed no response schema. The response type was read from the service table in the app bundle.

methods.name: SetGrokBotTemplateCreatorAttributionInternal
methods.function: Sets who a bot template is credited to. The only values seen in the schema are UNSPECIFIED and SYSTEM.
methods.returns: The operator view of the template.
methods.notes: The dossier showed no response schema. The response type was read from the service table in the app bundle.

methods.name: GetGrokBotHarnessMigrationStatusInternal
methods.function: Reads the harness migration state of one owner: rollout flags, hold state, each agent's harness, and the migration passes with their status and times.
methods.returns: rollout (migration gate, identity reads, temporal harness mode, host update trigger, ineligibility), hold_state, agents, passes, pass_history_available.

methods.name: ClearGrokBotHarnessMigrationHoldInternal
methods.function: Clears the migration hold on one owner so migration can go on.
methods.returns: cleared.

methods.name: PreviewInternalPrimaryBotMigration
methods.function: Dry run for moving internal users to the new primary bot, filtered by team ids and email suffixes. It lists owners with a migration status and counts, and returns a cohort hash and a preview token that the execute call needs.
methods.returns: owners, filtered_count, cohort_hash, preview_token, aggregate (current, ready, customized, missing and ambiguous system bots), total_owner_count, page_count.

methods.name: ExecuteInternalPrimaryBotMigration
methods.function: Runs the primary bot migration for the selected users. It needs the cohort hash, the preview token and a typed confirmation.
methods.inputs: team_ids; email_suffixes; selected_user_ids; cohort_hash; preview_token; confirmation.
methods.returns: outcomes per user and an aggregate (selected, migrated, already migrated, skipped, ambiguous, failed, bots converted, names and icons changed).

methods.name: AdminListGrokBotSessionBoxes
methods.function: Lists per-session boxes for a user or agent, with paging. Each row shows pod state, credential state, activity and reap times.
methods.returns: boxes (agent, session, tenant, store, times, pod state, pod count, credential state, box key) and next_page_cursor.

methods.name: AdminGetGrokBotSessionBox
methods.function: Reads one session box, and its host and store status when available.
methods.returns: box, host status, store status.

methods.name: AdminReapGrokBotSessionBoxNow
methods.function: Runs the idle-box clean-up on one session box right away. With dry_run it only counts what it would remove (pods, credentials, objects).
methods.returns: result, reason, tenant_id, dry_run, counts of pods, deleted pods, revoked credentials and deleted objects, stamp_cleared, box_key.

methods.name: AdminHibernateGrokBotSessionBox
methods.function: Puts one session box to sleep, optionally forced.
methods.returns: started, reason, tenant_id, box_key.

methods.name: AdminForceDeleteGrokBotSessionBox
methods.function: Force-deletes one session box: its pods and credentials.
methods.returns: deleted, reason, tenant_id, counts of deleted pods and revoked credentials, stamp_cleared, box_key.

methods.name: AdminGetGrokBotAgentDefinition
methods.function: Reads the full definition of one bot: identity, sessions, rooms, template imports, memory shards, routines, skills and MCP settings. identity_only returns just the identity.
methods.returns: identity (names, owner, harness, kind, visibility, Slack), definition, refusal text.
methods.notes: Exposes a user's bot configuration.

methods.name: AdminListGrokBotTeamAgents
methods.function: Lists a team's bots with owner email, last activity, session and routine counts. It also lists Slack apps left behind by deleted bots.
methods.returns: agents, team_name, truncated, orphaned_slack_apps, orphaned_slack_apps_truncated.

methods.name: AdminDeleteGrokBotAgent
methods.function: Deletes a team's bot and reports the result of removing its Slack app. The operator's email is recorded.
methods.returns: id and slack_app_removal (app id, workspace, status, error).

methods.name: AdminRetryGrokBotSlackAppRemoval
methods.function: Retries removing the Slack app of a deleted bot after an earlier removal failed.
methods.returns: slack_app_removal (app id, workspace, status, error).

methods.name: AdminGetGrokBotTeamAgentSharedState
methods.function: Reads what a team bot shares: participants, memory, marketplace status, plugins, routines, skills and boxes.
methods.returns: identity, owner_email, owner_multiplayer_gate, shared_state, refusal text.
methods.notes: Exposes a team's bot configuration.

methods.name: AdminListGrokBotEmailInboxes
methods.function: Lists a user's bot email inboxes with message counts, plus whether the email feature gate is on and the sending domain.
methods.returns: inboxes (email, domain, provider, times, message counts), gate_enabled, sending_domain.

methods.name: AdminListGrokBotEmailMessages
methods.function: Lists email message records for a user's inbox or thread, filtered by direction, with paging.
methods.inputs: user_id; inbox_email; thread_id; direction; limit; cursor.
methods.returns: messages (ids, subject, from and to addresses, delivery state, bounce type, auth results, raw storage URI, sizes) and next_cursor.
methods.notes: Exposes email metadata of a user.

methods.name: AdminSendGrokBotTestEmail
methods.function: Sends a test email from a user's bot inbox. The operator's email is recorded.
methods.inputs: user_id; from_inbox_email; to; subject; text_body; operator_email.
methods.returns: message_id, thread_id, provider_message_id.

methods.name: AdminGetGrokBotEmailSendingState
methods.function: Reads whether a user's bot may send email: state, effective state, reason, expiry times, stats and an event history.
methods.returns: has_account, state, effective_state, reason, changed_at_ms, expires_at_ms, reinstated_until_ms, automatic_enforcement_enabled, stats, events.
methods.notes: The dossier showed no response schema. The response type was read from the service table in the app bundle.

methods.name: AdminSetGrokBotEmailSendingState
methods.function: Sets a user's email sending state, for example to pause or restore sending (inferred from the expiry and reinstated-until fields). The operator's email is recorded.
methods.inputs: user_id; state; reason; expires_at_ms; reinstated_until_ms; operator_email.
methods.returns: The new sending state (same type as AdminGetGrokBotEmailSendingState).
methods.notes: The dossier showed no response schema. The response type was read from the service table in the app bundle.

methods.name: AdminGetGrokBotEmailLimits
methods.function: Reads a user's email send limits: default thresholds, overrides, effective thresholds and new-recipient settings.
methods.returns: has_account, default_thresholds_json, overrides_json, effective_thresholds_json, overridden_paths, new_recipients.
methods.notes: The dossier showed no response schema. The response type was read from the service table in the app bundle.

methods.name: AdminSetGrokBotEmailThresholds
methods.function: Sets per-user overrides of the email send limits. The operator's email and a reason are recorded.
methods.returns: The limits after the change (same type as AdminGetGrokBotEmailLimits).
methods.notes: The dossier showed no response schema. The response type was read from the service table in the app bundle.

methods.name: AdminListGrokBotEmailSuppressions
methods.function: Lists blocked email addresses (suppressions), filtered by user, address, domain, reason or date, with paging.
methods.inputs: user_id; address; domain; reason; created_after_ms; created_before_ms; limit; cursor.
methods.returns: suppressions (id, user, address, reason, bounce type, source message, time) and next_cursor.

methods.name: AdminAddGrokBotEmailSuppression
methods.function: Adds an address to a user's email suppression list, so the bot stops sending to it.
methods.returns: added and the suppression record.

methods.name: AdminRemoveGrokBotEmailSuppressions
methods.function: Removes suppressions for an address, for one user or for all users. expected_count guards against removing more than intended.
methods.inputs: address; user_id; all_users; expected_count; reason; operator_email.
methods.returns: removed: the suppression records that were removed.

methods.name: AdminLookupGrokBotMeetings
methods.function: Looks up bot meetings by provider and meeting id. Each result shows owner, agent, status, timeline and any failure.
methods.returns: provider, meeting_id, provider_meeting_id_hash, truncated, meetings.

methods.name: AdminLookupGrokBotMeetingsByAgent
methods.function: Looks up the meetings of one bot by agent reference.
methods.returns: status, agent_ref, agent, truncated, meetings.

methods.name: AdminGetGrokBotMeetingJoinConsent
methods.function: Reads when a user gave consent for their bot to join meetings.
methods.returns: consent_at_ms (empty if never given).

methods.name: AdminGetGrokBotMeetingTranscript
methods.function: Reads a meeting transcript, its summary text and the request log of the bot's meeting session.
methods.returns: access, transcript lines, truncated, summary_text, request_log, request_log_truncated, request_log_unavailable.
methods.notes: Exposes private meeting content.

methods.name: AdminMintGrokBotMeetingAvatarLinks
methods.function: Creates time-limited links for the bot avatar images used in meetings: one per shape and color, plus a custom link.
methods.returns: links (shape, color, url, expiry, ink) and custom_link (url, expiry).

methods.name: AdminGetGrokBotMeetingSummaryVersions
methods.function: Reads the versions of a meeting summary, one per time window, with the lines behind each.
methods.returns: access and versions (window, summary text, time span, lines).
methods.notes: Exposes private meeting content.

methods.name: CreateGrokBotChangelogInternal
methods.function: Creates a feature announcement (changelog) that bots can offer to users, with delivery window, priority, offer cap and client version limits. That reading is inferred from the field names.
methods.inputs: slug; feature_description; relevance_guidance; delivery_window (NEXT_WORKING_WINDOW or MORNING); not_before_ms; expires_at_ms; priority; announce_instructions; max_offers; eligibility_gate; min_client_version; min_ios_client_version.
methods.returns: The changelog (id, status, fields, who created and updated it, times).
methods.notes: The dossier showed no response schema. The changelog type was read from the service table in the app bundle.

methods.name: ListGrokBotChangelogsInternal
methods.function: Lists changelog announcements, optionally by status, with paging.
methods.inputs: status (DRAFT, PUBLISHED, PAUSED, ARCHIVED); page_size; page_token.
methods.returns: changelogs and next_page_token.

methods.name: GetGrokBotChangelogInternal
methods.function: Reads one changelog announcement by id.
methods.returns: The changelog.
methods.notes: The dossier showed no response schema. The changelog type was read from the service table in the app bundle.

methods.name: UpdateGrokBotChangelogInternal
methods.function: Edits a changelog announcement: text, delivery window, times, priority, offer cap and client version limits.
methods.inputs: changelog_id and the same fields as the create call.
methods.returns: The updated changelog.
methods.notes: The dossier showed no response schema. The changelog type was read from the service table in the app bundle.

methods.name: SetGrokBotChangelogStatusInternal
methods.function: Changes a changelog announcement's status, for example to publish, pause or archive it.
methods.returns: The updated changelog.
methods.notes: The dossier showed no response schema. The changelog type was read from the service table in the app bundle.
